experiment_data.hypothesis: W1 new MHA model: Pythia-1.4B hires bf16 2-bit-only profiling. 24L x 16H (MHA 1:1), 384 total heads, GPT-NeoX architecture. Tests whether concentration-dependent diagnostic generalizes to smaller MHA models outside Llama family.
experiment_data.notes: Pythia-1.4B (MHA 1:1, GPT-NeoX): Spike shape — concentration=0.24, t1/t5=1.94. Low concentration + high t1/t5 = few extreme outlier heads but bulk is moderate. L0 NOT dominant (0.51x), spikes in mid-layers (L1,L8-L17). Top head L1H11 delta=1.02, 2x the 5th head. MHA model showing Spike pattern like Yi/Llama despite different architecture family. Predicts: unconstrained MCKP should be safe (no catastrophe), MCKP may offer mild improvement over uniform.
